info.title: Krawl Dashboard API
info.description:
API endpoints for the Krawl honeypot dashboard.

Endpoints marked with a lock icon require authentication. Authenticate via `POST /api/auth` to obtain a session cookie.

get.description: Check if the current session is authenticated.
Small uncached snapshot used by the IP map's opt-in live mode.
Download unique usernames.txt and passwords.txt as a ZIP file.
Return current banlist source status for dashboard display.

post.description:
Delete generated deception pages from database.

Requires authentication. Can delete:
- All pages (delete_all=true)
- Pages created before a specific date (before_date=YYYY-MM-DD)
- Specific pages by ID (ids=id1,id2,id3)

get.description: Download a generated deception page as an HTML file.

post.description: Download multiple generated deception pages as a ZIP file.
Upload a custom page to serve as a deception page.
Validate and load a YARA rule file; the same name replaces the old one.

get.description: An uploaded rule file's source, as a download.

delete.description: Remove an uploaded rule file and unload its rules.

post.description: Upload multiple deception pages from a ZIP file.

get.description: List every discovered task with its schedule and current state.

post.description:
Run one discovered task now, in a worker thread.

Only names already present in the TasksMaster registry are accepted, so
this cannot be used to import an arbitrary module.

get.description:
The running configuration, with every secret redacted.

Sensitive fields report only whether they are set — that is the question
the panel exists to answer ("is my AI key actually loaded?") and it
discloses nothing.
